title: Review and inline-correct flagged receipt fields
userStory: As a user I can see receipts that need review and fix a wrong field so the row passes before export.
acceptanceCriteria: App.js shows a review affordance for needs-review receipts and lets the user edit a field, applying reviewQueue.applyCorrection and re-validating.
After a correction that resolves the mismatch, the needs-review indicator clears in the UI state.
The correction/apply wiring lives in a testable helper; App.js calls it.
npm test passes: correction clears the flag, a still-invalid correction keeps it; App.js source wires applyCorrection.
